plan: Normalize actions and build shared ordered blocks without mutating inputs.
Apply channel-specific escaping, masking, omission, link numbering, pagination, and SMS reduction rules.
Keep address/legal print blocks atomic and reject impossible SMS budgets.

trace.source_relation: typed master manifest → customer packet blocks
trace.target_mechanism: A shared ordered block builder supplies channel-specific renderers without mutating the packet.

trace.source_relation: route-specific disclosure marks → show, mask, or omit sensitive facts
trace.target_mechanism: Channel-aware fact formatting shows HTML values, masks plain-text values, and omits print/SMS sensitive facts.

trace.source_relation: coordinate reference ledger → links and reused footnote numbers
trace.target_mechanism: A first-seen URL registry assigns and reuses exact footnote numbers.

trace.source_relation: hazard or destination card → address or legal notice
trace.target_mechanism: Wrapped address and legal blocks are indivisible print pagination units.

trace.source_relation: radio-length rule with mandatory warnings → SMS character budget and mandatory wording
trace.target_mechanism: SMS reduction removes optional content in priority order while preserving actions and legal wording, then rejects impossible budgets.
